links.text:
SF’s dating pool was once, as an Egyptian founder put it to us, “drier than the desert in my homeland.”

Now, gorgeous women are flocking to the city.

Why? As AI gets cheaper to build, companies flush with venture cash are hiring beautiful women to charm investors and clients.

Enjoy it while it lasts, gentlemen. As @nicolewizman1 writes: paying hotties 6 figures to get drunk with your business prospects feels like a pretty good sign we’re in a bubble. 👇
